text:
deploy-bot: preflight failed: SBOM mismatch detected for pkg://infra/telemetry@v2.3.1 -> transitive dep 'crypto-lite' has non-FIPS build
deploy-bot: vuln-scan flagged CVE-2024-9999 in crypto-lite (score 7.6) but marked as 'transitive, optional'
sam: saw this during canary, SBOM shows different build-id than release artifact. repro steps I used: `sha256sum dist.tar.gz` vs `sbom.json`.
lisa: is the mismatch because of the internal base image change yesterday? @michael you changed baseimage tag in the RC.
michael: I bumped baseimage to `redwood/base:2024-03-07-patched` to pick up kernel fixes — didn't expect crypto-lite to change artifacts, might be a rebuild consequence.
sec-team-bot: request for approval: Security triage required. Options: 1) pin crypto-lite to v1.4.2 and proceed 2) roll back baseimage change 3) block release and open hotfix. Please provide business impact if blocked.
sam: product says must hit change window today or push to next day; rolling back baseimage likely delays. Pinning looks fastest if it doesn't regress.
lisa: dev-tests green when I force-pinned crypto-lite v1.4.2 locally. No immediate regression on telemetry path.
sec-team-bot: approval note: temporary pin requires companion issue in security backlog with mitigation plan within 48h and CVE suppression policy entry.
release-manager: summarizing: we can do emergency pin + create mitigation ticket, then run a limited canary in prod region us-west-2 for 2 hours. If canary passes, proceed with release during today change window. Anyone object?
sec-team-bot: security approval granted conditionally: pin + mitigation ticket (#SEC-427) + monitor. Logging requirement: enable extra audit for crypto calls for 24h.
michael: ack, I'll commit pin and push a hotfix branch. Pushing PR now: `github.com/redwood/infra/pull/6123`
sam: I'll run the canary and monitor latency/error budget. tagging @release-manager for final go/no-go after 2h canary. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
release-manager: noted. If canary OK, I'll merge and proceed with deploybot change-window exemption. If not, we'll rollback baseimage and schedule new change window.
lisa: adding SBOM regen and provenance note to PR description so legal/compliance can sign off quickly.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: release/2024.3.20-pin-crypto-lite -> canary-us-west-2 (manual approval required)
release-manager: approving canary start. starting canary at 2019030835.
sec-team-bot: reminder: for any suppression of vulns, include CVE timeline + internal risk acceptance sign-off in the mitigation ticket.
michael: created issue SEC-427 with plan and timeline. link: https://go/repo/SEC-427
sam: canary metrics look stable after 45m, small spike in tail latency (+4ms) but error rate flat.
release-manager: good to proceed. merging PR and promoting canary -> full rollout during window. thanks team. :thumbsup:
